During `--nobuild --nodeps --noprepare`, neither `prepare()` nor `build()` are executed, so no package logic runs.
- The source definitions use standard prebuilt binary patterns (tar.gz from GitHub releases) and point to the official lark-cli repository. This is typical AUR packaging practice and poses no security risk.

In summary, the file contains only standard, verifiable prebuilt binary sources with proper checksums. The `makepkg` commands will fetch and extract these known-good artifacts without executing any untrusted code.
